meta.name: story-cover
meta.description: 小说封面生成。根据书名、作者名自动分析题材风格，调用 GPT-Image-2 生成含标题和署名的专业级网文封面；Codex CLI 优先使用内置 ImageGen，无需单独 API Key。触发方式：/story-cover、/封面、「帮我做个封面」「生成封面图」「做个小说封面」「封面设计」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入书名与作者名,自动生成带标题和署名的网文封面图
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在写网文、需要封面但不会用设计软件
copy.tagline_en: Turn a book title and author name into a ready-to-publish web-novel cover image
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write web novels and need a cover without design tools

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会根据书名和作者名判定题材风格,调用图像模型生成含中文书名和作者署名的竖版小说封面,并可裁成平台要求的上传尺寸。
howto.when: 当你提到「/story-cover」「/封面」等说法,或要求做小说封面、生成封面图时触发;缺书名或笔名会先问你补全。

say.text: 帮我做个封面,书名《XX》,笔名 XX
say.note: 会先问封面存哪个目录,再出图

say.text: 封面换个构图,改成人物特写
say.note: 基于上一版提示词微调重出

say.text: 也导一份番茄平台上传尺寸的封面
say.note: 原图保留,另存 600×800 裁剪版

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude reads your title and author name to judge the genre, calls an image model to produce a portrait novel cover containing both, and can crop it to a platform's upload size.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "/story-cover" or "/封面", or ask it to make a novel cover; if the title or pen name is missing it asks you first.

say_en.text: Make a cover for my novel, title XX, pen name XX
say_en.note: asks where to save, then generates

say_en.text: Redo the cover with a character close-up
Also export the Tangguo upload-size cover
say_en.note: keeps the original, adds a 600x800 crop
